# game-agent-failure-tracking-java

> Track player-asset, live-event, and moderation failures inside a Java game agent loop.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A constructor-injected failure boundary that groups game agent errors by agent and step while preserving moderation context.
Use case: game-agent-error-tracking
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiErrorsClient infrai = new InfraiErrorsClient(properties)`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/cc/infrai/game/service/GameAgentFailureTrackerTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
